description: With the nunu.ai plugin, you can automate your QA testing. Author test cases in natural language and run them end to end on real Android and iOS devices, Windows VMs, and Browsers. Automatically inspect past runs, review bugs, and update test cases. Create complete test plans and run them on every new build or on a schedule.

defaultPrompt: Set up a one-hour discovery test, create a test plan for it, and schedule it to run every Sunday night.
Review my latest test runs, investigate failures, and summarize the bugs with supporting evidence.
